description:
Migrate the two inversion thresholds to runtime resolved reads.

## Background

The follow-on selector migration design (dev/active/7d824b2f/design.md) governs this task; read it in full. Its §2 fixes the two field kinds and the mechanism rule with four structural read-pattern obligations, §3 gives every field its name, range, default-naming constant, read site and mechanism, §4 names the route reporter and test obligation per family, and §5.3 states the ratified amortisation screening rule and the behaviour-preservation argument (defaults name the in-source constants; observable behaviour unchanged when no profile is installed). Design §3.4 and the dense_inverse row of §4.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: m4ri_min_dim and blocked_min_dim are runtime resolved reads satisfying design §2.3, operators unchanged.
- [hard] REQ-02: invert_route reporter called by the dispatcher and route files on both sides of each threshold pass.
- [hard] REQ-03: Rustdoc names the profile fields; existing tests pass unchanged.
title: Cut the dense-inversion selectors over to the tuning profile
